jobs.title: Research Scientist, AI
jobs.description:
**Company**
-----------

Pramaana Labs is a frontier AI lab building the verification layer for AI. We turn complex human knowledge, including tax codes, legal rules, clinical guidelines and security protocols, into formal representations that support reasoning people can inspect and check. Our architecture pairs models trained to formalize and reason with a symbolic world model encoded in Lean 4. Founded in 2025 and headquartered in Palo Alto, Pramaana brings together researchers and formal methods experts from Google, DeepMind, and Glean.

**The Role**
------------

We’re training models to formalize complex knowledge and reason with symbolic world models. As a Research Scientist focused on AI, you’ll develop approaches that improve the accuracy, coverage, efficiency, and generalization of our domain formalizer, autoformalizer, and prover.

Your scope spans model training, data quality, representations, and evaluation. You’ll work with an RL Scientist on reinforcement-learning approaches, Research Engineers on reliable experimentation, and Formal Methods experts on whether model outputs faithfully represent the source knowledge.

**What You'll Do**

* Lead ambitious research at the intersection of foundation models, formal reasoning, and verification, advancing Pramaana's mission to make AI reasoning reliable across complex, real-world domains.
* Develop novel model training and post-training approaches for translating complex domain knowledge into structured representations and enabling precise, verifiable reasoning.
* Drive hands-on research in reinforcement learning, synthetic data generation, reasoning, and agentic AI, exploring new techniques to advance model capabilities, generalization, and efficiency.
* Own and lead end-to-end research initiatives, identifying high-impact directions, setting technical strategy, and guiding teams of researchers and engineers while remaining deeply involved in the technical work.
* Develop rigorous benchmarks and evaluation methodologies to measure reasoning capabilities, robustness, and generalization, using experimental insights to drive fundamental model improvements.
* Partner closely with engineering to translate research breakthroughs into production capabilities, delivering measurable improvements in the performance and reliability of Pramaana's technology.

**You Will Thrive in This Role If You Have**

* A demonstrated track record of high-impact research, including research projects that have been successfully deployed and materially advanced a product, core technology, or organization's capabilities and direction.
* Deep hands-on experience in foundation model training and post-training, including one or more of large-scale pretraining, reinforcement learning, reasoning-focused training, or synthetic data generation.
* Strong technical depth in modern AI research, including frontier language models, agentic systems, multi-step reasoning, or structured prediction.
* Proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks such as PyTorch or JAX, with experience implementing and scaling training experiments.
* Exceptional research judgment and experimental rigor, with the ability to identify promising directions, formulate hypotheses, design meaningful evaluations, and distinguish genuine advances from incremental gains.
* Demonstrated technical leadership and independence, with experience driving ambitious research initiatives, mentoring scientists, and collaborating effectively across research and engineering while remaining a strong individual contributor.

**Especially Strong Candidates May Also Have**

* Direct experience training or post-training frontier-scale models, including distributed training, large-scale reinforcement learning, or inference-time scaling.
* Research experience in neuro-symbolic AI, autoformalization, automated theorem proving, program synthesis, or formal verification.
* A strong research record demonstrated through influential publications, deployed research breakthroughs, or substantial improvements to state-of-the-art model capabilities.

jobs.title: Research Engineer
jobs.description:
**Company**
-----------

Pramaana Labs is a frontier AI lab building the verification layer for AI. Founded in 2025 and headquartered in Palo Alto, we turn complex human knowledge, including tax codes, legal rules, clinical guidelines and security protocols, into a formal representation, so every AI answer can be traced, challenged, and proved. Pramaana's architecture pairs foundation models trained to formalize and reason with a symbolic world model encoded in Lean 4. Pramaana was founded by a team out of Google, DeepMind, and Glean, combining frontier AI researchers and formal methods experts.

**The Role**
------------

We’re looking for a Research Engineer to build and improve the systems that turn complex knowledge into formal representations and use them to reason and prove. You’ll work closely with researchers and formal methods engineers on Pramaana’s domain formalizer, autoformalizer, and prover, making these systems more accurate, repeatable, and efficient.

This is a hands-on role combining software engineering with careful experimentation. Your work could include building model and tool orchestration, improving evaluation, developing data pipelines and training environments, or implementing new representations. You’ll own a focused workstream based on your strengths and the team’s needs, with room to contribute across the research stack.

You’ll take ideas from an initial experiment to a tested implementation, investigate failures, and measure whether changes improve correctness, coverage, latency, and cost.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Build next-generation neuro-symbolic AI systems at the intersection of foundation models, formal methods, automated reasoning, and verification.
* Design rigorous evaluation frameworks and research benchmarks to study reasoning capabilities, generalization, robustness, and computational efficiency.
* Develop advanced post-training and data synthesis pipelines, exploring techniques in synthetic data generation, reinforcement learning, and model self-improvement.
* Research and implement approaches to knowledge representation, compositional reasoning, program synthesis, and constraint-based inference for complex real-world domains.
* Drive end-to-end research and engineering, from rapid prototyping and controlled experimentation to ablation studies, performance optimization, and scalable production systems.

**You Will Thrive in This Role If You Have**
--------------------------------------------

* Strong software engineering fundamentals and hands-on experience building large-scale ML systems, research infrastructure, or high-performance training pipelines.
* Experience training or post-training large foundation models, including distributed training, fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and large-scale experimentation.
* Deep proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks, such as PyTorch, JAX, DeepSpeed, FSDP, Megatron-LM, or equivalent distributed training and inference infrastructure.
* Experience building agentic AI systems, including tool use, multi-step reasoning, agent orchestration, and evaluation of complex model behaviors.
* Familiarity with modern post-training techniques, including supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, preference optimization, synthetic data generation, and reasoning-focused training.
* Strong research and experimental judgment, with experience designing benchmarks, running ablation studies, analyzing model failures, and translating research ideas into measurable improvements.
* Ability to operate independently at the intersection of research and engineering, rapidly prototyping ambitious ideas and scaling successful experiments into robust systems.

**Especially Strong Candidates May Also Have**
----------------------------------------------

* Experience building autoformalization, theorem-proving, or other systems that combine models with symbolic tools.
* Experience with Lean, Coq, Isabelle, SMT solvers, compilers, or program analysis.
* Experience optimizing model inference, parallel workloads, or evaluation pipelines for speed and cost.
* Substantial research code, open-source contributions, or projects that demonstrate strong engineering and experimental work.

Prior experience in formal verification is not required. We value strong engineering, careful experimentation, and the curiosity to learn how models and formal systems work together.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon is seeking exceptional talent to help develop the next generation of advanced robotics systems that will transform automation at Amazon's scale. We're building robotic systems that combine frontier AI, sophisticated control, and advanced mechanical design to create adaptable automation capable of working safely alongside humans in dynamic environments. This is an opportunity to shape the future of robotics and automation at an unprecedented scale, working with world-class teams pushing the boundaries of what's possible in robotic manipulation, locomotion, and human-robot interaction.
  
  
We are seeking an Applied Scientist to develop tactile- and force-driven manipulation policies for highly dexterous, multi-fingered robotic hands and grippers. In this role you will research and build policy learning algorithms that enable robotic hands to perform grasping and in-hand manipulation in unstructured, real-world environments, using touch and force feedback as first-class signals rather than afterthoughts. Much of this work is grounded in reinforcement learning.
  
  
To be successful you need to be highly motivated, dive deep, and deliver to the highest standards. You will demonstrate strong working knowledge of modern policy learning methods, with expertise in taking algorithms from simulation onto real hardware. That means being comfortable working against real physical constraints and treating sim-to-real as a core research problem rather than optimizing for benchmark numbers alone. You will work across tactile signal processing, contact-rich manipulation, sim-to-real transfer, and multi-modal sensor fusion to build robust solutions for autonomous grasping, dexterous re-orientation, and fine motor control. You will bring the desire to learn from new challenges, and the problem-solving and communication skills to work within a highly interactive and experienced team.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Design and train manipulation policies that leverage tactile and force feedback for dexterous grasping, in-hand manipulation, and contact-rich tasks, using reinforcement learning, imitation learning, or hybrid approaches.
* Drive sim-to-real transfer, closing the gap between simulated and physical performance on real robotic hands.
* Shape objectives and control strategies with the hardware in mind, accounting for how motors and actuators actually behave: transmission ratios, torque versus power, backdrivability, and thermal limits.
* Build simulation-based and on-robot evaluation frameworks, with benchmarks and metrics that make tactile perception and policy performance systematically comparable across iterations.
* Own scientific and technical projects within the tactile sensing and manipulation workstreams, driving from research concept through deployment on physical robotic systems — and, at the senior level, set direction across a workstream.
* Collaborate with hardware, mechanical design, firmware, and controls teams — and with partner applied science organizations — to translate research advances into deployable robotic capabilities, and to inform sensor and actuator design decisions with policy-level requirements.
* Publish at top-tier venues and build collaborations with the external research community.
* Contribute to a strong scientific bar on the team through code and design review, and mentor engineers and interns working on real-world manipulation and sensing problems.

  
A day in the life  
Your morning might start with a standup alongside hardware and controls engineers reviewing overnight sim-to-real training runs on a multi-finger gripper, debugging why a grasp policy that worked in simulation is slipping on a real sensor array. Mid-morning you join the weekly tactile sensing workstream to align on sensor integration milestones and share early results from a contact-state estimator you have been prototyping. After lunch you spend a focused block iterating on a reinforcement learning reward formulation, testing variations in simulation before queuing runs on the cluster. Later you pair with a mechanical engineer to review sensor placement trade-offs on an upcoming gripper revision, then wrap the day by drafting a short experiment write-up and sketching next steps for a conference submission.
  
  
No two days look exactly the same: one week you may be collecting teleoperated demonstrations on the physical robot to seed an imitation learning pipeline; the next you could be deep in a codebase refactor to support a new tactile modality. Throughout, you balance hands-on research — writing algorithms, running experiments, analyzing data — with cross-team collaboration and mentoring. The common thread is moving from research insight to working capability on real hardware, with a tight feedback loop between simulation and the physical world.
  
  
About the team  
Our is developing next-generation manipulation capabilities for highly dexterous multi-fingered grippers and hands. Our work spans tactile sensor development, manipulation policy learning, and the tight integration of sensing hardware with intelligent control software. We are building systems that can feel, adapt, and manipulate with human-level dexterity.
  
  
You will join a team working at the frontier of tactile sensing and contact-rich manipulation, helping define how robots perceive and interact with objects through touch. Because we build the hands as well as the policies that drive them, you will have a direct line to the sensor, actuator, and mechanism designs your algorithms depend on — and real influence over how they evolve. This is an opportunity to solve hard problems across perception, learning, and physical interaction alongside a team of scientists and engineers building toward real-world deployment.

Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.

  
  

**What We Offer**

  

Salary:

$100,000.00 - $136,500.00

Location:

Santa Clara,CA

You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits .

**Position Overview:**

We are seeking a Product Manager with a strong emphasis on data science to define and deliver data-driven products, analytical capabilities, and intelligent workflows. This role sits at the intersection of customer needs, business strategy, data, and technology. It offers the opportunity to lead high-impact, cross-functional initiatives that develop end-to-end AI solutions, from problem formulation through production deployment. The Product Manager will translate complex problems into a clear product vision and roadmap, partner closely with data scientists and engineers, and guide solutions from discovery through launch and continuous improvement.

  
  

The ideal candidate combines product judgment, analytical fluency, and strong cross-functional leadership. They can evaluate when advanced analytics or machine learning is appropriate, establish meaningful success metrics, and communicate technical tradeoffs to both technical and business audiences.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and communicate a compelling product vision, strategy, and roadmap for data science–enabled products and capabilities.

* Identify high-value customer and business problems through research, data analysis, stakeholder interviews, and market insight.

* Translate product opportunities into clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and measurable outcomes.

* Partner with data science, data engineering, software engineering, design, and business teams throughout discovery, development, validation, launch, and adoption.

* Work within cross-functional project teams to develop complex analytical models, algorithms, and automated processes that address challenging business and customer problems.

* Drive the development of machine learning models across the full lifecycle, from problem definition and initial concept through validation, production deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

* Apply data mining and machine learning algorithms to generate insights from historical and real-time data for use cases such as material forecasting, demand forecasting, pattern recognition, and related business challenges.

* Engage with stakeholders to analyze requirements, special requests, and schedules; derive actionable insights; and partner with business units to define actions and the key performance indicators used to measure their impact.

* Identify opportunities to improve forecast accuracy and provide Service Supply Chain leadership with business insights and additional perspectives that inform planning and decision-making.
